title: Artem's Blood Sugar Now Lives on the Family Kiosk | vitalii.no
description:
Artem's blood sugar readings already existed in the sugar hub bridge, but nobody could see them without opening a separate app. The kiosk — the screen the whole family already checks for the calendar and the camera tile — showed nothing about whether his sugar was fine or dropping, so checking meant stopping to pull out a phone.

A new /sugar route on the youtube-gate Cloudflare Worker proxies the sugar hub, authenticates with a secret key, and strips the response down to only the value, trend arrow, level and age before it ever reaches the kiosk — no raw medical payload leaves the Worker. KioskFrame.tsx renders this as a small badge laid directly over Artem's existing calendar photo tile, with a built-in staleness check.

If the reading is older than 15 minutes, the badge turns grey instead of showing a number that might already be wrong.
